description: Applying a peer's document record (WebDAV parent-version semantics, automatic resolution). The local replica holds `baseline.markdown` accepted at `baseline.version` (the version a successor must name as its parent), optionally with an unsynced local edit. A remote record names its parent in `ver`. Concurrent edits never stop sync: local content stays, a differing remote body becomes a conflict copy, and the local edit is republished as the successor (`republishedVersion`). Identical bodies (ignoring surrounding whitespace) resolve without a copy, ancestors are ignored and replays of this device's own journal are never conflicts.

scenarios.name: concurrent edit keeps local content and copies the remote body
identical concurrent bodies resolve without a copy
stale ancestor from a compacted journal is ignored
own journal replay never conflicts with a pending edit
